review.heightMaxStories: Taller buildings must set the extra height back one foot from the street line for every two feet above six stories.
review.sideSetbackMin: A corner lot that abuts an apartment district needs 25 ft on the side street. Other lots that abut an apartment district need 10 ft.

notes: The existing Corporate One building may use any use allowed under its Phase One development plans, as well as any listed use.

At least 80 percent of the exterior walls of all structures must be masonry, not counting door and window openings. All facades visible from a divided thoroughfare must be brick or stone construction. Glass tile, glass block and plate glass may count as masonry.
Before a development plan is approved, owners within 200 ft are notified and a public hearing is held.
Loading facilities must be screened. On lots that abut a 4-lane divided thoroughfare, no loading facility may face it or sit on the side next to it.
Outside sales and commercial promotions need a permit: up to 14 days a year and two permits per business per year, with goods on a sidewalk within 10 ft of the building.
Long-term outside storage of equipment, buildings, goods and products is prohibited, except on construction sites.
Mechanical equipment must be screened from public streets. Refuse containers must be screened from public rights-of-way and sit on a reinforced concrete pad.
